title: Bounded local optimization around Round 1 optimum with ±2.5 nm per-layer clip
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining the optimizer search to a narrow thickness manifold (±2.5 nm) around the Round 1 optimum will prevent phase overshoot while allowing fine-tuning of the interference conditions, recovering or exceeding the 0.5036 target score.
design_principle: Local refinement within validated thickness region preserves the constructive/destructive interference pattern that achieved Round 1 performance while allowing minor adjustments to compensate for manufacturing-relevant thickness variations.
proposed_topology: 20-layer alternating stack: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (20 variables, bounded ±2.5 nm from Round 1 baseline)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 255-280 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 300-700 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 700-1100 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: ±2.5 nm bounds represent realistic deposition tolerance
HfO2 and SiO2 are conventional depositable dielectrics
theory_basis: Bounded optimization prevents search from leaving validated performance manifold
expected_advantages: Prevents optimizer from overshooting into poor-performance regions
Maintains Round 1 interference conditions while allowing fine-tuning
known_risks: ±2.5 nm bounds may be too restrictive if Round 1 optimum was not at local maximum
May not recover Round 1 score if degradation was due to layer count reduction (21L to 20L)
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating multilayer stack on fused silica substrate for solar-blind UV filter application. Wavelength bands: 255-280 nm (high transmittance target), 300-700 nm (suppressed transmittance), 700-1100 nm (suppressed transmittance). Air incidence, normal angle, unpolarized. Initialize thicknesses from Round 1 baseline: [32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17, 32.62, 45.17] nm. Apply hard clip bounds of ±2.5 nm per layer during optimization. Use multi-start gradient-based local optimizer with 10 random starts within bounds. Material registry resolves HfO2 and SiO2 optical constants. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, thicknesses_nm for all valid candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: re-initialize from Round 1 baseline thicknesses with ±2.5 nm per-layer hard clip bounds to prevent phase overshoot. Replaces unconstrained search with bounded multi-start local optimizer confined to validated thickness manifold.
